punchline: Try not to think of a white bear, and it will keep turning up.
thirty_sec: In Wegner's 1987 experiment, people first asked to avoid thinking of a white bear rang the bell for it more often afterwards than people who were free to think of it from the start.
question: Which thought are you trying to push out of your head right now?
key_contrast: A banned thought does not leave; your mind keeps checking for it.
